title: Radon Seasonal Drift
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radon:reading
| search radon_bq_m3=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(radon_bq_m3) as avg_radon_bq_m3 by _time season
| sort - _time
description: Tracks seasonal radon drift over time and breaks it out by season.
value: Seasonal drift is often the dominant pattern in radon data and sets the context for every alert threshold.
implementation: Send seasonal radon drift events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of seasonal radon drift by season.
grandmaExplanation: It records how seasonal radon drift changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
